fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. Uses one unified remote scene-anchor pipeline for physical furniture, free-standing and wall scenes, with synchronized participant alignment, scene controls and NPC undressing. v0.34.1 keeps the validated PPA synchronization and the owner-authoritative OCum snapshot handling from v0.34.0, and explicitly replays the same RaceMenu/SKEE CumOverlays materialization path that works in free-standing scenes after a physical TESFurniture scene has settled. Bounded replays run after furniture START/NODE transitions and after new CumOverlays appear, without changing OCum equip meshes or free-scene behavior.
